title: From Uncertainty to Clinical Risk: Severity-Aware Conformal Planning for Interactive Medical Diagnosis
summary: Interactive medical diagnosis dynamically acquires patient information through multiple rounds of questioning, supporting accurate, efficient, and safe clinical decisions under incomplete evidence. Existing methods commonly guide information acquisition with predictive uncertainty or label ambiguity, but overlook the asymmetric clinical risk of missing severe diseases and lack unified long-horizon planning over whether to continue asking questions or commit to a diagnosis. To address these limitations, we propose Severity-Aware Conformal Clinical Planning, which formulates interactive diagnosis as a risk-sensitive sequential decision problem. The framework maintains complementary diagnostic, safety, and masked-evidence beliefs; calibrates turn-specific diagnostic prediction sets and severity-weighted differential-diagnosis risk on held-out diagnostic trajectories; and introduces the calibrated clinical risk into Monte Carlo Tree Search to jointly evaluate long-horizon Ask and Commit trajectories. Experiments on DDXPlus and MediQ show that our method achieves more accurate diagnoses with fewer questions across multiple large language models, while improving differential-diagnosis quality and reducing high-risk errors in severe cases. These findings validate the value of using clinical risk, rather than predictive uncertainty alone, as a planning signal and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework for information acquisition and risk-aware diagnostic decision making. They also motivate future work on clinical-risk-oriented interactive diagnosis and information-acquisition methods.
tldr: Proposes a severity-aware conformal planning framework for interactive medical diagnosis that integrates clinical risk into Monte Carlo Tree Search to balance information acquisition and diagnosis commitment, reducing high-risk errors in severe cases.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种严重性感知的共形规划框架，用于交互式医疗诊断，将临床风险集成到蒙特卡洛树搜索中，以平衡信息获取与诊断决策，减少严重病例的高风险错误。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
交互式医疗诊断通过多轮问询动态获取患者信息，支持在不完整证据下实现准确、高效且安全的临床决策。现有方法通常利用预测不确定性或标签模糊性引导信息获取，但忽视了遗漏严重疾病的非对称临床风险，且缺乏对“继续提问”或“给出诊断”的统一长程规划。为解决这些局限，我们提出严重性感知共形临床规划（Severity-Aware Conformal Clinical Planning），将交互式诊断建模为风险敏感的序贯决策问题。该框架维护互补的诊断信念、安全信念与遮蔽证据信念；在预留的诊断轨迹上校准每轮次的诊断预测集及严重性加权鉴别诊断风险；并将校准后的临床风险引入蒙特卡洛树搜索，以联合评估长程的“提问”与“诊断”轨迹。在DDXPlus和MediQ上的实验表明，我们的方法在多个大语言模型上能以更少问题实现更准确的诊断，同时提升鉴别诊断质量，减少严重病例中的高风险错误。这些结果验证了以临床风险（而非仅预测不确定性）作为规划信号的价值，并展示了所提框架在信息获取与风险感知诊断决策中的有效性。同时，它们也激励了未来面向临床风险的交互式诊断与信息获取方法研究。

title: FedEHR-Agents: Federated Agentic Optimization for Automated EHR Modeling
summary: Recent advances in large language models are enabling autonomous clinical agents to perform increasingly complex electronic health record (EHR) modeling workflows. However, agents deployed at individual hospitals remain constrained by institution-specific data and modeling environments, while direct cross-hospital collaboration is restricted by the sensitivity of patient-level EHR data. Although federated learning (FL) provides a natural foundation for privacy-preserving collaboration, existing approaches remain predominantly model-centric, limiting federation to prediction models or their updates while overlooking the richer modeling experience accumulated by autonomous agents. To address this limitation, we propose FedEHR-Agents, an experience-centric federated agentic optimization framework for automated EHR modeling. Each hospital deploys an autonomous clinical EHR agent that performs data preprocessing and model development while refining local clinical modeling experience through historical memory, task-specific evaluation, and TextGrad-based prompt refinement. The federated server performs evidence-guided experience aggregation to integrate reliable and complementary modeling experience across heterogeneous hospitals and distills the aggregated experience into global meta-prompts for subsequent local refinement. Extensive experiments on real-world multi-hospital EHR benchmarks demonstrate that FedEHR-Agents consistently outperforms local and federated baselines across diverse clinical prediction tasks and remains robust across different federation scales and LLM backbones. These results establish clinical modeling experience as a promising collaborative object beyond conventional parameter-centric FL and point toward federated autonomous clinical intelligence.
tldr: FedEHR-Agents proposes a federated framework where autonomous clinical agents share modeling experiences (via prompts) instead of model parameters, enabling privacy-preserving collaboration across hospitals for automated EHR modeling.
tldr_zh: FedEHR-Agents提出了一种联邦框架，其中自主临床代理共享建模经验（通过提示）而非模型参数，从而实现跨医院的隐私保护协作，用于自动化电子健康记录建模。
summary_zh: 近期，大语言模型的进展使得自主临床智能体能够执行日益复杂的电子健康记录（EHR）建模工作流程。然而，部署在单个医院的智能体仍受限于机构特定的数据和建模环境，而直接的跨医院协作则受限于患者级EHR数据的敏感性。尽管联邦学习（FL）为隐私保护协作提供了自然基础，但现有方法仍以模型为中心，将联邦限制在预测模型或其更新上，忽略了自主智能体积累的更丰富的建模经验。为解决这一局限，我们提出FedEHR-Agents——一种以经验为中心的联邦智能体优化框架，用于自动化EHR建模。每个医院部署一个自主临床EHR智能体，负责数据预处理与模型开发，同时通过历史记忆、任务特定评估以及基于TextGrad的提示词优化来精炼本地临床建模经验。联邦服务器执行证据引导的经验聚合，整合来自异构医院中可靠且互补的建模经验，并将聚合后的经验蒸馏为全局元提示，供后续本地精炼使用。在真实多医院EHR基准上的广泛实验表明，FedEHR-Agents在多种临床预测任务中一致优于本地及联邦基线，并在不同联邦规模及大语言模型骨干下保持稳健。这些结果确立了临床建模经验作为一种超越传统以参数为中心的FL的有前景协作对象，并指向联邦自主临床智能。

title: Explainable Uncertainty Estimation for Reliable Medical AI
summary: Artificial intelligence has strong potential to support clinical decision-making, yet its adoption in healthcare remains limited due to a lack of trust. Uncertainty estimation can signal unreliable predictions, and explainable AI (XAI) can clarify how predictions are made but existing methods treat them separately, providing no feature-level insight into why a prediction is uncertain or which tests to prioritize to reduce it. To address this gap, we propose explainable uncertainty estimation, which unifies uncertainty estimation and XAI to both quantify uncertainty and explain feature-level contributions. We introduce the Expected Gradients Reconstruction Uncertainty Estimate (egRUE), which incorporates prediction explanations into its uncertainty computation and decomposes uncertainty into feature-wise contributions. We prove theoretical properties of egRUE and show through experiments that it improves reliability and interpretability compared to existing methods. A user study with medical experts further demonstrates that egRUE's explanations improve calibrated trust over uncertainty scores alone, increasing confidence in correct predictions and reducing confidence in incorrect ones. By combining prediction uncertainty with feature-level explanations, egRUE strengthens decision-making support in safety-critical healthcare settings, clarifying both when predictions may be unreliable and which features drive that uncertainty.
tldr: This paper proposes egRUE, a method that unifies uncertainty estimation and explainable AI to provide feature-level explanations for prediction uncertainty, improving trust and reliability in medical AI through theoretical guarantees and a medical expert user study.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了 egRUE 方法，将不确定性估计与可解释 AI 统一起来，提供特征层面对预测不确定性的解释，通过理论保证和医学专家用户研究提高医疗 AI 的信任和可靠性。
summary_zh: 人工智能在支持临床决策方面潜力巨大，但由于缺乏信任，其在医疗领域的应用仍然有限。不确定性估计能够识别不可靠的预测，可解释人工智能（XAI）可以阐明预测的生成方式，但现有方法将二者分离处理，无法从特征层面解释预测为何存在不确定性，也无法指明应优先进行哪些检测来降低不确定性。为填补这一空白，我们提出了可解释的不确定性估计方法，该方法将不确定性估计与XAI相统一，既能量化不确定性，又能解释特征层面的贡献。我们引入了预期梯度重构不确定性估计（egRUE），该方法将预测解释融入不确定性计算，并将不确定性分解为各个特征的贡献。我们证明了egRUE的理论性质，并通过实验表明，与现有方法相比，它提升了可靠性与可解释性。一项针对医学专家的用户研究进一步表明，与仅使用不确定性评分相比，egRUE的解释能够改善校准信任，即增强对正确预测的信心，降低对错误预测的信心。通过将预测不确定性与特征层面的解释相结合，egRUE强化了安全关键医疗场景中的决策支持，既阐明了预测何时可能不可靠，又明确了哪些特征导致了这种不确定性。

title: ChainSplat: A Physics-Inspired Screw-Theoretic Model for Learning Deformable Linear Object Dynamics from Multi-View RGB Videos
summary: Identifying the underlying dynamics and 3D geometry of deformable linear objects (DLOs), such as cables, ropes, and hoses, is essential for accurate robotic manipulation, but remains challenging due to their high-dimensional configuration spaces and diverse behaviors arising from varying material properties. Existing methods often rely on multi-stage pipelines and auxiliary depth inputs, which are prone to errors under dynamic interactions, while their high-dimensional state representations make model-based control computationally expensive. In this paper, we introduce ChainSplat, a physics-inspired framework that jointly learns the 3D geometry, appearance, kinematics, and dynamics of DLOs solely from multi-view RGB videos. ChainSplat represents a DLO as an open-chain structure of rigid links connected by revolute joints, yielding an analytic, screw-theoretic model with a compact state representation parameterized by joint configurations. By integrating this formulation with Gaussian splatting, ChainSplat jointly recovers DLO dynamics, kinematics-aware 3D geometry, and appearance, while enabling high-fidelity RGB rendering from arbitrary states. Through real-world experiments, we demonstrate that ChainSplat achieves state-of-the-art performance in dynamics predictions, 3D geometry reconstruction, and RGB rendering across dynamic interactions. ChainSplat further enables real-time state and force estimation, as well as accurate model-based trajectory optimization, highlighting its practical utility for real-world robotic manipulation of DLOs. Accompanying source code and video are available at: https://chainsplat.github.io.
tldr: ChainSplat is a physics-inspired framework that learns 3D geometry, appearance, kinematics, and dynamics of deformable linear objects from multi-view RGB videos using a screw-theoretic model combined with Gaussian splatting, achieving state-of-the-art performance in dynamics prediction and enabling real-time state and force estimation for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: ChainSplat 是一个受物理启发的框架，利用螺旋理论模型结合高斯泼溅，从多视角 RGB 视频中学习可变形线性物体的3D几何、外观、运动学和动力学，在动力学预测中达到最先进性能，并支持实时状态和力估计以用于机器人操作。
summary_zh: 识别可变形线性物体（DLOs，如电缆、绳索和软管）的潜在动力学与三维几何结构，对于实现精确的机器人操控至关重要。然而，由于其高维构型空间以及因材料属性差异而产生的多样化行为，这一任务仍具挑战性。现有方法通常依赖多阶段流程和辅助深度输入，在动态交互下容易产生误差，同时其高维状态表示导致基于模型的控计算成本高昂。本文提出ChainSplat——一种受物理学启发的框架，该框架仅从多视角RGB视频中联合学习DLO的三维几何、外观、运动学与动力学。ChainSplat将DLO表示为通过旋转关节连接的刚性连杆开链结构，从而得到一种解析的螺旋理论模型，其状态表示由关节构型参数化的紧凑形式。通过将该形式与高斯泼溅（Gaussian splatting）相结合，ChainSplat联合恢复了DLO的动力学、运动学感知的三维几何与外观，并实现了任意状态下高保真的RGB渲染。通过真实世界实验，我们证明ChainSplat在动态交互中的动力学预测、三维几何重建和RGB渲染方面达到了最先进的性能。ChainSplat还进一步实现了实时的状态与力估计，以及基于模型的精确轨迹优化，突显了其在真实世界机器人操控DLO中的实际应用价值。附带的源代码和视频见：https://chainsplat.github.io。

title: Propagating construction-time knowledge quality into medical question answering: A framework grounded in clinical guidelines
summary: Large language models have facilitated knowledge graph (KG) construction from clinical guidelines, but extracted triples vary in structural validity and evidential support. Meanwhile, graph-augmented question answering (QA) systems typically optimize query relevance during retrieval, with limited reuse of quality information produced during KG construction. This creates a disconnect between construction-time quality control and inference-time evidence use. We investigate whether construction-time triple quality can serve as a persistent signal for downstream evidence selection and presentation. We propose a quality-aware framework that models structural conformance (SchemaConf) and evidential support (EvidScore) as complementary dimensions and fuses them into a per-triple quality signal, Q(t). Rather than using quality solely for filtering, the framework retains Q(t) and derived quality tiers as graph attributes and propagates them into quality-weighted subgraph retrieval and tier-conditioned evidence prompting, while preserving passage-level provenance. Experiments on Chinese diabetes clinical guidelines show that the utility of the quality signal is distribution dependent. Under cross-version and cross-model shift, the fused Q(t) provides stronger triple-quality discrimination than either component alone (AUC 0.748 vs. 0.703 for EvidScore and 0.645 for SchemaConf). In guideline-grounded QA, propagating construction-time quality reduces required-knowledge omission from 16.3% to 5.3% and conflicting outputs from 16.3% to 2.7%, with an evidence-grounded precision of 81.6% and near-zero invalid citations. Blinded clinician ratings favor the full framework over no retrieval (4.68 vs. 4.21 on a five-point scale) and approach the oracle condition (4.80), while cross-generator experiments show consistent trends.
tldr: This paper proposes a quality-aware framework that propagates construction-time triple quality (structural conformance and evidential support) into medical question answering over clinical guideline knowledge graphs, showing significant improvements in reducing knowledge omission and conflicting outputs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个质量感知框架，将构建时的三元组质量（结构一致性和证据支持）传播到基于临床指南知识图谱的医学问答中，显著减少了知识遗漏和冲突输出。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型促进了从临床指南中构建知识图谱（KG），但所提取的三元组在结构有效性和证据支持方面存在差异。同时，图增强的问答（QA）系统通常在检索过程中优化查询相关性，而对知识图谱构建过程中产生的质量信息复用有限。这导致了构建时质量控制与推理时证据使用之间的脱节。我们探究了构建时的三元组质量能否作为下游证据选择与呈现的持久信号。我们提出了一种质量感知框架，将结构符合度（SchemaConf）和证据支持度（EvidScore）建模为互补维度，并将其融合为每个三元组的质量信号Q(t)。该框架不仅将质量用于过滤，还将Q(t)及派生出的质量层级作为图属性保留，并将其传播到质量加权的子图检索和基于层级的证据提示中，同时保留段落级别的来源信息。在中文糖尿病临床指南上的实验表明，质量信号的效用具有分布依赖性。在跨版本和跨模型迁移下，融合后的Q(t)比任一单独分量提供更强的三元组质量区分能力（AUC 0.748，对比EvidScore的0.703和SchemaConf的0.645）。在基于指南的问答中，传播构建时质量将所需知识的遗漏率从16.3%降至5.3%，冲突输出从16.3%降至2.7%，基于证据的精确率达到81.6%，且无效引用接近为零。盲法临床医生评分中，完整框架优于无检索条件（五点量表上4.68对比4.21），并接近理想条件（4.80），而跨生成器实验显示出一致的趋势。
